title: Fix Windows native dev and build flows, repo MCP and agent hooks, sketchpad/desktop, coda/desktop, and Semio.Grasshopper; remove Unix-only command assumptions and validate monorepo commands on Windows.
summary: Continued multi-platform cross-platform work. Fixed Python dependency resolution (uv sync --all-packages --group test), added typing._eval_type monkey-patch in conftest.py for Pydantic/Python 3.14 beta compatibility, and updated all agent hook/MCP config files (.claude/settings.json, .github/hooks/repo.json, .github/hooks/semio-repo.json, .kiro/settings/mcp.json, .kiro/agents/semio.json) to use cross-platform go run ./repo/cli instead of ./repo/cli/cli binary paths. Verified all platforms: Go (5 modules build clean), .NET (0 errors, 63/67 tests pass), Python (240/246 pass), JS/TS vitest (154/155 pass), Electron desktop apps (both semio and coda build Windows installers).
